meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动画成动态架构图,让评审一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次看改动都要花很久弄清它到底动了哪里
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into animated architecture diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if figuring out what a change actually did takes forever

howto.what: 把一次代码改动或代码库的一部分画成带动画的架构图或数据流图。它写入 .pr-lens/graph.json、校验后渲染成 SVG,可推送到在线画布并返回链接,或作为图片附到 pull request 里。
howto.when: 当你要求把某次改动或某个系统画成图、可视化或解释,或希望 pull request 带上一张图时触发。关键词如 PR Lens、diagram、architecture、pull request 等。

say.text: 把这次改动画成架构图,给我链接
say.note: 读 diff、写文档、校验、渲染并推送画布,返回视图链接

say.text: 在这张画布上解释 push 第一步检查什么
say.note: 相机逐步移动,提到的组件会亮起并带链接

say.text: 把这张图附到这个 PR 的描述里

howto.what_en: PR Lens draws a code change or part of a codebase as animated architecture or data-flow diagrams. It writes .pr-lens/graph.json, renders animated SVGs, and can push them to a canvas link or attach them to a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. Keywords include PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, pull request.

say_en.text: Diagram this change as an architecture view and give me the link
say_en.note: Reads the diff, validates, renders, then pushes a canvas.

say_en.text: On this canvas, explain what push checks first
say_en.note: The camera steps through and the names light up with links.

say_en.text: Attach this diagram to the open pull request description
say_en.note: Uploads the SVG with gh pr edit --attach.
